text:
A customer texts "how much?" at 7:40 PM.

The reply that books the job: the real price, what's included, two specific times, one question.

This is what that looks like for an example detailing business. The owner reads it and hits send.

The full structure, with a free prompt you can paste into Claude: https://autopilotoi.app/guides/reply-to-price-inquiry/?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=front_desk&utm_content=fd-price-1

Messages that arrive after hours are often the most ready to buy.

You don't have to answer at 9 PM. Acknowledge fast, batch the real replies in the morning, and ask the one detail you need to price it.

Notice the [CHECK]: when it doesn't know if a time is open, it says so instead of guessing.

The system: https://autopilotoi.app/guides/after-hours-customer-messages/?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=front_desk&utm_content=fd-late-1

A quote with no reply isn't always a no. People get busy.

Day 2: repeat the price, offer a time.
Day 5: answer the likely objection.
Last one: close the loop politely.

Then stop. Most owners never send even the first one.

Example messages for each: https://autopilotoi.app/guides/follow-up-on-a-quote/?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=front_desk&utm_content=fd-chase-1
